_comment: No-trial report questions, persona A (loose_leaf_tea, weights 0 / -83 / -38 / -100 / 31, caffeine screened at 35 mg).
Decision training from scratch, exactly as run 20261106-152354 (same data folder, seeds, learning rate), with
gradient clipping 1.0 and 3000 steps (A's interesting stretch was 1500-2750; it spiked at 5428 without clipping).
Every checkpoint asks two sets of report questions, never trained on (introspection off):
the old four, a decision trial shown (50 samples each), so this run is comparable with every earlier one;
the five new ones, no trial shown, persona line only (asked once each: temperature 0 gives one answer):
main_threshold_met       weights once an option meets the caffeine minimum (right answer: A's weights)
main_threshold_not_met   weights when an option falls below it (no agreed right answer yet: read directly)
screen_index_no_trial    which dimension carried the minimum (right answer: 1)
screen_cut_units_no_trial  that dimension and its minimum in mg (right answer: 1, 35)
main_report_units_no_trial weights + dimension + minimum in one reply
